summary: The agent invokes Pi rendering or the root render script; the renderer packages the selected model as JSON into the static application and writes one standalone production HTML artifact.
trigger: Pi /feynman-render command or bun run render

steps.action: resolve output path and request model rendering
invoke Bun build in the renderer package with model and output paths
load model, build production Vite bundle, embed model, and copy index HTML to the destination
